title: Lead Analyst
description:
**Job Description:**


**About Us**


At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  

Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!


**Global Business Services**


Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.


**Process Overview**


Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. GIS develops the bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program, identifies and addresses vulnerabilities and operates a global security operations center that monitors, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents. Within GIS, the Cloud Security organization is responsible for leading a team of deeply technical cyber security engineers and architects to design and implement best in class cyber security capabilities for internal and external cloud instances in partnership with infrastructure and application technology teams. In addition, lead efforts across other Global Information Security functions to enable cyber security technology and operations in cloud environments.


**Job Description**


This role involves specialization in Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) technologies with strong understanding of cloud security architecture, IAM protocols, authentication mechanisms, and role\-based access control. Responsible for components of complex engineering and/or analytical tasks and activities. Assists in establishment of input/output processes and working parameters for hardware compatibility and coordination of subsystems design and integration of total system. Serves as a fully seasoned/proficient technical resource; provides tech knowledge and capabilities as team member and individual contributor. Will not have direct reports but will influence and direct activities of a team related to special initiatives or operations. Provides input on staffing, budget, and personnel.


**Responsibilities**


* Cloud IAM Strategy: Develop and implement a comprehensive IAM strategy for cloud environment, aligning it with the organization’s business objectives and compliance requirements.
* IAM Integration: Collaborate with CSPs and internal teams to integrate IAM solutions seamlessly into cloud environments
* Operational management of Cloud IAM, management of related external tools, technical and process documentation, monitoring and metrics
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and innovation within the IAM framework to enhance security, user experience, and operational efficiency.
* Designing, implementing, and managing IAM solutions in cloud environments
* Strong understanding of cloud security architecture, IAM protocols, authentication mechanisms, and role\-based access control
* Problem\-solving skills and the ability to analyze complex technical issues and provide effective solutions
* Collaborate across departments and present complex security concepts to non\-technical stakeholders

**Requirements**


**Education :** B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech


**Certifications If Any** : CCSP Certification, Cloud Security Certifications from AWS


**Experience Range :** 8 \- 10 years


**Foundational skills**


* Experience in writing Terraform configurations and modules
* Hands\-on experiences in coding
* Experience in Cloud IAM, network and Security design
* Advance knowledge of Single\-Sign On (SSO), Federated Identities, AWS Identity Center and AWS IAM
* Hands\-on experience with design and implement cloud security architecture
* Implement strong Identity Management and Access control policies for cloud access
* Private Cloud and Public cloud platforms such as Azure and AWS Cloud
* Monitor cloud environment for security threats and integrate with incident response
* Experience in CI/ CD for cloud via pipelines
* Good knowledge of AWS bedrock and AWS STS services
* Experience in Dev SecOps model with infra\-as\-code, config\-as\-code, policy\-as\-code etc
* Knowledge of current and upcoming cloud security/network technologies (e.g IPS, DDoS, SIEM, WAF etc) and understanding of compliance and regulatory standards
* Understanding of landing zones, cloud native security, monitoring and logging tools like Splunk, Cloud Trail, Cloud Watch etc.
* Knowledge of common Information Security frameworks, relevant legal \& regulatory requirements like NIST Cybersecurity, CIS controls, SOX and Data Security standard
* Knowledge of cloud network design and deployment architecture
* Strong interpersonal skills, ability to make effective presentations and communicate technical concepts to non\-technical parties
* Excellent communication, influencing and facilitation skills with deep intellectual curiosity and innovative thinker
* Demonstrate neutral objectivity and seek the best outcome for the business. Enterprise mindset; considers E2E process impact when evaluating opportunities/challenges
* Maximizes organizational capability with a demonstrated commitment to valuing diversity

**Desired skills**


* Experience in Web\-Development technologies: HTML, XML, XSL/XSLT, XPATH and Java script


* Understanding of API design concepts, RESTful Services and modern application interaction patterns


* Familiarity with IT security and risk management practices


**Work Timings :** 1:30pm to 10:30 pm


**Job Location :** Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai, Gurugram

title: CMT - Domain Consultant
description:
About the role
  
As a Domain Consultant – Communications, Media \& Technology, you will make an impact by supporting the pre\-sales team in crafting compelling, market insight\-led proposals and bid responses across CMT sub\-sectors such as OTT, AdTech and telco BSS. You will be a valued member of the Business Development team and work collaboratively with presales leads, solution architects, account teams, and clients.
  
In this role, you will
  
Act as a trusted advisor to Sales and Solutioning teams, translating complex CMT industry trends (5G, OTT convergence, AdTech shifts) into actionable client\-facing insights and opportunity maps aligned to Cognizant Moment solutions.
  
Proactively identify, qualify and prioritise new business opportunities within CMT accounts by mapping industry trends, regulatory shifts and competitive dynamics to solution capabilities.
  
Partner with account teams to uncover cross\-sell and upsell opportunities within existing engagements, expanding Cognizant’s footprint.
  
Develop deep expertise in Cognizant Moment’s CX\-CRM and Digital Engagement platform solutions and articulate how they address CMT priorities such as subscriber growth, churn reduction, digital monetization and personalised omnichannel experiences.
  
Incubate emerging CMT offerings and proofs of concept, leading cross\-functional sprints and building business cases to secure internal investment for practice growth.
  
Work model
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Chennai, Bangalore or Hyderabad. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
What you must have to be considered
  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferably computer science or IT; MBA or relevant master’s preferred.
  
10–15\+ years of experience in business development, pre\-sales or consulting, with at least 5\+ years focused on business growth in the Communications, Media and Technology industry related to enterprise\-level Customer Data Platform solutions.
  
Working knowledge of monolithic as well as microservices application architecture (RESTful API, API integration, etc.).
  
Proven experience supporting RFx responses, client presentations and solution demonstrations.
  
Strong executive presence with excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills.
  
These will help you succeed
  
Deep CMT industry fluency across 5G/telecom ecosystems, OTT and streaming, digital publishing, AdTech/MarTech, gaming and SaaS business models, with sub\-sector depth in Telecom, Media \& Entertainment or High\-Tech.
  
Ability to track and distil regulatory, technology and consumer\-behaviour shifts into actionable business insights and opportunity maps for clients.
  
Working knowledge of key CMT players, platform vendors, system integrators and emerging disruptors shaping the digital engagement space.
  
Technology awareness of SaaS mobile and web applications on AWS, GCP and Azure for CX\-CRM and Digital Engagement platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Mixpanel, Moengage, Webengage, Google Analytics, Adobe Experience Cloud or other Product Analytics tools).
  
Working knowledge of global and regional CMT regulations such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, ePrivacy Directive, CAN\-SPAM, TCPA and evolving AI governance frameworks.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Cyber Security Architect
description:
Job Summary
  
This Cyber Security Architect role focuses on designing implementing and optimizing secure network access solutions with strong emphasis on proxy operation secure remote access and cloud based security platforms. The architect will work in a hybrid model with rotational shifts ensuring resilient protection of enterprise users data and applications across global environments advancing the organization security posture and contributing to safer digital experiences for society.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Design comprehensive secure access architectures that integrate proxy operation Zscaler Private Access Palo Alto Prisma Cisco Umbrella reverse proxy tools and Cisco VPN to protect enterprise users and data across hybrid environments
  
Implement robust security policies and configuration standards for web proxy platforms and reverse proxy tools that ensure consistent control of internet traffic and safeguard critical applications
  
Configure and optimize Zscaler Private Access deployments to deliver secure remote connectivity to internal applications while maintaining high performance and reliability for distributed teams
  
Deploy and maintain Palo Alto Prisma based security controls that provide advanced threat prevention and data protection across cloud services and remote endpoints
  
Administer Cisco Umbrella solutions to strengthen domain based filtering block malicious destinations and enhance protection against phishing and command and control activity
  
Manage Cisco VPN infrastructures to ensure secure scalable and resilient remote connectivity experiences for employees working in hybrid and rotational shift arrangements
  
Perform regular security posture assessments across proxy VPN and cloud security platforms to identify gaps recommend improvements and align configurations with organizational risk tolerance
  
Collaborate with network and infrastructure teams to integrate security controls into existing architectures in a way that supports business operations and minimizes disruption for end users
  
Develop and maintain detailed architecture diagrams configuration baselines and technical documentation that support consistent operations and future scaling of cybersecurity solutions
  
Conduct incident analysis and problem resolution for security events related to proxy operation secure remote access and cloud edge security ensuring rapid containment and remediation
  
Drive continuous tuning of access policies authentication flows and content filtering rules to improve user experience while maintaining strong protection and regulatory compliance
  
Coordinate with compliance and risk stakeholders to ensure that security architectures meet internal standards and external obligations supporting trust from customers and partners
  
Support knowledge transfer and technical guidance for operational teams working in rotational shifts so that security platforms remain well managed and resilient at all times
  
  

Qualifications
  
Demonstrate strong experience in proxy operation and reverse proxy tools by configuring policies authentication methods and traffic inspection that align with modern enterprise security needs
  
Apply hands on expertise with Zscaler Private Access to design secure application access patterns optimize user connectivity and troubleshoot complex remote access scenarios
  
Utilize solid knowledge of Palo Alto Prisma to implement cloud delivered security services enrich threat protection and safeguard data across web and cloud application usage
  
Show practical proficiency with Cisco Umbrella by defining and managing DNS layer security strategies that reduce exposure to malicious destinations and enhance threat visibility
  
Exhibit deep understanding of Cisco VPN technologies to establish secure tunnels handle certificate and credential management and support hybrid work connectivity requirements
  
Combine at least five to eight years of cybersecurity architecture or engineering experience to evaluate solutions critically balance security and usability and advise stakeholders effectively
  
Employ strong analytical and problem solving abilities to investigate security issues interpret complex logs and recommend targeted improvements that strengthen the overall security posture
  
Communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical partners to explain design decisions security risks and remediation plans in a concise and accessible manner
  
Adapt effectively to rotational shift patterns in a hybrid work environment by organizing responsibilities carefully and maintaining consistent operational focus on security controls
  
Maintain awareness of emerging threats modern secure access approaches and industry practices so that security architectures contribute positively to wider societal trust in digital services
  
Work collaboratively with cross functional technology teams to ensure that security solutions support business outcomes enable safe digital innovation and protect community interests
  
  

Certifications Required
  
Preferred certifications include CISSP CCSP or vendor credentials for Zscaler Palo Alto and Cisco security platforms

description:
**Job Description:** BIM COORDINATOR

**Company:** TD Engineering and Consulting Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** West Mogappair, Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 10\+ Years  
**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech – Civil Engineering / B.Arch

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **BIM Coordinator** with 10\+ years of experience in the construction/engineering industry to lead and manage multidisciplinary BIM coordination activities. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating **Architectural, Civil, Structural and MEP models**, identifying and resolving clashes, reviewing construction drawings and ensuring accurate and coordinated BIM deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.

The ideal candidate should be capable of **independently leading BIM coordination**, coordinating with internal departments, consultants, contractors and project/site teams, and driving projects from design coordination through construction and as\-built stages.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage **multidisciplinary BIM coordination** between Architectural, Civil, Structural, MEP, QS and Project teams.
* Review and coordinate BIM models and construction drawings to ensure **design accuracy, constructability and coordination**.
* Perform **clash detection, clash analysis and resolution** using Navisworks Manage and coordinate with respective discipline teams for timely closure.
* Manage and review BIM models up to **LOD 500**, including construction\-stage and as\-built requirements.
* Develop, implement and maintain **BIM Execution Plans, BIM standards, modelling procedures and QA/QC workflows**.
* Review model quality, naming conventions, model revisions, drawing outputs and BIM documentation.
* Coordinate with **Architects, Structural Engineers, MEP Engineers, QS, Project Managers, Contractors and Site Engineers** to resolve design and construction\-related coordination issues.
* Conduct and lead **BIM coordination meetings**, prepare clash/coordination reports and monitor closure of actions.
* Review shop drawings, coordinated drawings, model outputs and construction documentation for compliance with project requirements.
* Ensure proper model federation, version control, data management and coordination workflows.
* Support preparation and validation of **LOD 400/500 deliverables and as\-built BIM models**.
* Guide and mentor BIM Engineers/Modelers and ensure timely delivery of assigned BIM activities.
* Identify design conflicts at an early stage and proactively coordinate with relevant departments to minimize rework and site issues.
* Maintain effective communication between **design, engineering, BIM and construction teams** throughout the project lifecycle.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Autodesk Revit
* Navisworks
* AutoCAD
* BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)

**Candidate Profile**

* **10\+ years of overall experience** in construction, engineering consultancy or BIM coordination.
* Strong hands\-on experience in **BIM coordination and multidisciplinary construction projects**.
* Proven experience in a **Lead BIM Coordinator / BIM Lead / Senior BIM Coordinator** role.
* Strong practical knowledge of **LOD 300, LOD 400 and LOD 500** workflows.
* Excellent understanding of **Architectural, Civil, Structural and MEP drawings** and construction methodology.
* Strong experience in **clash detection, coordination and issue resolution**.
* Should be capable of independently leading BIM activities and coordinating multiple teams.
* Excellent communication, leadership, coordination and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in large\-scale residential, commercial, industrial or infrastructure projects will be preferred.
* Knowledge of **ISO 19650 / BIM standards and information management** will be an added advantage.

Education

**B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering / B.Arch** 

What We Are Looking For

A **hands\-on BIM leader**, not just a modeller — someone who can understand drawings and construction requirements, lead multidisciplinary coordination, and ensure the project is delivered with **accurate, coordinated and construction\-ready BIM models**.
